name: relay
description: Automatically continue long-running Codex Goals in fresh threads at 30% context usage.

interface.longDescription: At the default 30% context threshold, Relay reads the current Codex Goal, starts a genuinely fresh app-server thread in the same repository, restores the Goal objective, and continues with a compact live-repo handoff.
defaultPrompt: Keep Relay enabled while this Goal runs; it automatically starts a fresh thread when context reaches 30%.
In a destination thread, inspect live repository state and continue the same Goal objective without relying on the predecessor transcript.
